audit.why: 48.68% over 756 games. You own levels 2-3 before Shadow Dash exists, Shen takes over from 4 once the taunt is up, you get one first-item window, and he out-scales behind armour and a global.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart reads Jayce|Skill|Shen|Shen|Jayce|Shen|Shen but the captions say the opposite: whys[0] says 'neither of you owns level 1', whys[1] calls level 2 a 'clean Jayce window', whys[2] says the full pattern punishes any walk-up at 3, and whys[3]/[4] are both written about level 6.
audit.why: The caption block is offset from the stages it sits under. Packet reference chart reads Skill|Jayce|Jayce|Shen|Shen|Jayce|Shen, which is what the prose actually describes.
audit.corrected: Sides re-set to Skill, Jayce, Jayce, Shen, Shen, Jayce, Shen, and whys[3]/[4] rewritten so 4-5 covers Shadow Dash coming online and 6 covers the ults.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Spirit's Refuge as a blanket block. Riot's text: 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked' — attacks only.
audit.why: This is the decisive interaction and it cuts your way. Shock Blast, the gate-accelerated Shock Blast and Thundering Blow all pass straight through Spirit's Refuge; only the post-swap auto and Hyper Charge shots are eaten. Knowing that turns a 16s bubble from a reason to back off into a free poke window.
audit.corrected: mid now says the W blocks attacks only and to poke through it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly says 'when the taunt is down' without ever giving the number.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is 18/16/14/12/10s and Spirit's Refuge 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s; Twilight Assault is only 8s so it is not the window. The 18s E at rank 1 is the whole lane.

edits.before: At 6 the Shadow Dash taunt plus W block let Shen win the all-in, and your R is only a stance swap, not new burst to answer it.
edits.after: Shadow Dash is up: an 18s taunt at rank 1 drags you out of your combo and Spirit's Refuge eats the post-swap auto — give nothing here.

edits.before: Behind an armor item Shen soaks your shred-empowered hits and his global R lets him swing the map — the scaling tilts to him.
edits.after: Your R is only the stance swap while Stand United hands him a global — at 6 the taunt all-in is his window, not yours.

edits.before: Once Shen has Shadow Dash (E) the whole lane revolves around its cooldown. When that taunt is up, give nothing — if he dashes in he taunts you out of your combo and Spirit's Refuge blocks your cannon-swap auto and Hyper Charge shots mid-trade. The moment he burns Shadow Dash on the wave or a bad angle, gate-Q him and run the full Cannon-Q into Hammer Q-E-W. Remember your R is only the stance swap, not new burst, so at 6 the taunt all-in is genuinely his window — and his global R means he can leave to flip another lane.
edits.after: Once Shen has Shadow Dash (E) the lane revolves around its 18s rank-1 cooldown. While the taunt is up, give nothing — he dashes in, taunts you out of your combo, and Spirit's Refuge blocks your cannon-swap auto and Hyper Charge shots. But the W blocks ATTACKS only: Shock Blast and Thundering Blow go straight through the bubble, so poke it instead of waiting it out. The moment he burns Shadow Dash on the wave, gate-Q and run the full Cannon-Q into Hammer Q-E-W. Your R is only the stance swap, so at 6 the taunt all-in is his.

edits.before: Gate-Q (E into Cannon Q) his last-hit step-ups while Shadow Dash is on cooldown
edits.after: Gate-Q (E into Cannon Q) his last-hit step-ups while his 18s Shadow Dash is down

notes: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not abilities — Shock Blast and Thundering Blow pass through it. The page implied a blanket block. Stand United carries a 'channel — interruptible' derived flag in the kit file, but Riot's own description does not say so, so I did not put any Thundering-Blow-cancels-his-ult claim on the page; recorded as unverified. 'Time Spirit's Refuge' in wants.foe[1] is a false-positive suspect (the verb 'Time').
